reminders.label: 10 days before
reminders.action: Review medication guidelines. Consult prescribing physicians about blood thinners and diabetic medications.

reminders.label: 7 days before
reminders.action: STOP blood thinners (Coumadin, Plavix, Effient), weight-loss meds (Ozempic, Wegovy, Mounjaro, etc.), vitamins/supplements (fish oil, iron, multivitamins, Vitamin E, St. John's Wort).

reminders.label: 3 days before
reminders.action: Start LOW FIBER/LOW RESIDUE diet. Stop nuts, seeds, corn, popcorn, raw fruits, raw vegetables, whole wheat, multi-grain, bran, fiber supplements.

reminders.label: 2 days before
reminders.action: Continue low-fiber diet. Confirm adult driver (18+). Take meds as usual unless directed otherwise.

reminders.label: 1 day before
reminders.action: Start CLEAR LIQUID DIET. NO solid foods. Drink plenty of clear liquids throughout the day.

reminders.label: 1 day before — 6 PM
reminders.action: First SUPREP dose: Pour 6oz bottle into mixing container, add plain water to 16oz line, mix well, drink within 30 min. Then drink TWO additional 16oz containers of clear liquid within 30 min.

reminders.label: Day of — 6 hours before
reminders.action: Second SUPREP dose: Same as first dose (6oz + water to 16oz, drink within 30 min, then 2 more 16oz of clear liquid over next hour). Prepare to wake up for this.

reminders.label: Day of — 4 hours before
reminders.action: STOP all liquids. Nothing by mouth. Brush teeth OK but don't swallow. Blood pressure/anti-seizure meds ONLY with small sip of water if needed.

reminders.label: Day of — leave for procedure
reminders.action: Leave for Endoscopic Imaging Center. Bring photo ID, insurance card, medication list. Driver must be present.

reminders.label: Post-procedure
reminders.action: NO driving, alcohol, legal decisions, or strenuous activity for remainder of day. Rest.
